WDIP.NoShots: This firearm is out of shots.
WDIP.SettingsAutoConsumeHint: When you roll a firearm, automatically reduce its current shots by 1.
WDIP.WeaponHint: For firearms, pips represent shots. If this box is not checked, the weapon behaves like a normal Mausritter item.
WDIP.HelpPinnedHint: Pinned · Press Esc or click outside to close
WDIP.HelpNoDescription: This item does not have a description yet.
WDIP.HelpStrength: The mouse's physical power. Used to endure, carry, grapple and overcome danger through force.
WDIP.HelpDexterity: Speed, coordination and precision. Used to dodge, move quietly and react in time.
WDIP.HelpHeart: Nerve, will and courage. Used to keep calm and withstand fear or pressure.
WDIP.HelpLead: The character's immediate resilience. Damage reduces this value before threatening their attributes.
WDIP.HelpGrit: The toughness needed to keep moving when the frontier bares its teeth.
WDIP.HelpPips: Shared ammunition reserve. Each shot from a marked firearm spends 1 point.
WDIP.HelpInventory: Items the mouse has readied, worn or packed. Hover over a card for two seconds to read it.
WDIP.HelpNotes: Free space for clues, debts, wounds, promises and other frontier trouble.
